summary: Comprehensive testing of appointment system - All features working. 14/14 backend tests pass, all UI tests pass. Immobilier/automobile appointment types, admin filters, confirm modal with meeting_address/meeting_contact all functional.
passed_tests: POST /api/appointments - Create immobilier appointment with appointment_type=immobilier, property_id, property_title
POST /api/appointments - Create automobile appointment with appointment_type=automobile
POST /api/appointments - Create general appointment (default type)
GET /api/admin/appointments - List all appointments
GET /api/admin/appointments?appointment_type=immobilier - Filter by immobilier type
GET /api/admin/appointments?appointment_type=automobile - Filter by automobile type
GET /api/admin/appointments?appointment_type=general - Filter by general type
PUT /api/admin/appointments/{id} - Confirm with meeting_address and meeting_contact persisted
PUT /api/admin/appointments/{id} - 404 for non-existent appointment
GET /api/admin/appointments/stats - Stats endpoint returns total/pending/confirmed/completed/cancelled
POST /api/admin/appointments/send-reminders - Manual trigger reminders
Admin endpoints require authentication (401 for unauthenticated)
Appointment validation - Missing required fields returns 422
Appointment validation - Invalid email returns 422
PropertyDetailPage - 'Demander une visite' button present
PropertyDetailPage - Click opens appointment modal with immobilier theme (green header)
Appointment modal - Home icon for immobilier type
Appointment modal - All form fields present (name, phone, email, date, time, message)
Appointment modal - Submit button says 'Demander une visite' for immobilier
Admin appointments page - Type filter buttons (Tous/Immobilier/Automobile/Général)
Admin appointments page - Type badges visible in table (Immobilier/Automobile/Général)
Admin appointments page - Stats cards (En attente/Confirmés/Terminés/Total)
Admin confirm button - Opens modal
Confirmation modal - Date/time pre-filled from preferred values
Confirmation modal - Meeting address field (Adresse du rendez-vous)
Confirmation modal - Meeting contact field (Contact sur place)
Confirmation modal - WhatsApp checkbox
